notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, as the county reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.

Lincoln County's cities, towns and plantations collect the county tax with their own property tax bills and pay it over. Public schools are run by school districts and municipal school departments, so they are not included.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: contributions to Maine county candidates were not loaded.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
